( KM and LH) Please do not use these two reviews to make a decision about Cook Lane Surgery. Whilst we are happy to receive reviews( good or bad) the whole scenario was not relayed in either of these reviews.  Both reviews are negative because the people in question did not allow us to make things right. Whilst we understand patients can become frustrated, they must allow us to rectify. K.M hasn't mentioned that he was unreasonable, abusive and aggressive to said member of staff and removed from the practice list for abusive outbursts. I wonder if his comment about all the practices in the area is a reflection on his own unreasonable expectations of the NHS and perhaps not one surgery will be good enough to meet his demands? L.H hasn't mentioned that we asked her to book an appt on the day that suited her and she chose to leave it 3 weeks before getting in touch. I have tried to reply to both reviews but unable. Our real reviews are on NHS Choices where we having glowing results. 84% of our patients recommend us and 91% are delighted with our reception staff. It is a real shame that patients who like to get things off their chest get the limelight. We are very proud of all our hard working staff who face abuse and aggression on a daily basis. Perhaps if people weren't so quick to vent to write negativity and allow us to reply, we would come to a resolution before negative comments are posted.
